# Pons Sniper Bot

Open-source TypeScript CLI for pons.family v2 on Robinhood Chain (chain ID 4663).

- Sniper: detect TokenLaunched, filter, quote, risk-check, optional curve buy. Dry-run by default.
- Bundler: launchAndBuy plus up to 32 snipe-tax exemption wallets.

Site: https://wooyang.github.io/pons-bundler/
Bundler: https://wooyang.github.io/pons-bundler/bundler.html
Docs: https://docs.ponsfamily.com/v2
Source: https://github.com/wooyang/pons-bundler
